messages:
Maya: quick heads-up — we saw a persistent cost delta for traces that go through late-enrich; cohorts diverge after enrichment windows :eyes:
Kevin: paste the agg/query you used?
Maya: simplified: 
select cohort_id, sum(cost) from traces
where ingested_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
group by cohort_id
but delta only shows up when tenant-lookup happens during late-enrich (post-ingest).
Sam: sounds like the billing key appears late issue. currently we fallback to an 'unknown' bucket and run a patch job later, right?
Maya: yup. fallback -> "unknown", reconcile job patches ~70% successfully, ~30% remains unknown. finance noticed big tenants in the unknown bucket.
Irene: finance flagged chargeback mismatches for a few high-value tenants. they need near-real-time accuracy.
Kevin: root cause: edge doesn't always forward customer_id, we sometimes only have ephemeral session ids. late-lookup maps session->account but fails for old sessions.
Sam: proposal: emit a provisional_billing_key at edge when any hint exists. include provenance and TTL. Queries can prefer provisional for realtime dashboards, while final billing relies on reconciled final_billing_key. Tradeoffs: extra cardinality and some provisional misassigns.
Irene: cardinality is a worry. can we emit a low-card provisional_cohort instead of full tenant id? finance needs final tenant ids for chargeback though.
Kevin: two-tier idea: provisional_cohort (low-card) + final_billing_id (nullable). Realtime uses cohort; billing uses final id after reconciliation. Less index churn in realtime.
Sam: adds complexity: query layer must join provisional->final mapping for historical queries. need deterministic reconciliation logs so backfills are reproducible.
Maya: minimal envelope sketch: 
{
  "trace_id": "...",
  "provisional_billing_key": "acct:123||cohort:v2",
  "provisional_ttl": 86400,
  "final_billing_key": null,
  "billing_provenance": "edge-probe-v1"
}
adds ~12-40 bytes/envelope typical.
Irene: can we avoid changing every envelope by emitting a separate lightweight provisional-key event for trace_id? storage engines charge per-field.
Sam: separate event reduces envelope size but complicates ordering. aggregation may see trace before provisional event. we'd need ordering guarantees or defer finalization.
Kevin: we already have deferred finalization for other flows. aggregation could mark soft-missing and wait X seconds before attributing to unknown.
Maya: ops/ingest: canary this on flag 'experiment/prov-billing' for 2% traffic? @ingest-bot what's rollout path.
ingest-bot: canary path available. we can inject provisional key for 2% of edge traffic. backfill workers can be throttled.
Sam: testing plan: 1) RFC for schema + reconciliation contract 2) infra canary at 2% 3) daily reconcile for canary cohort 4) compare finance reports vs gold source.
Kevin: perf/cost: index size up ~1.5% for canary. reconciliation job cost small.
Irene: finance acceptance: discrepancy <0.1% and no tenant sees undercharge window >24h.
Maya: action items: Sam -> write RFC; Kevin -> prototype query join helper; Maya -> run small canary once infra flags ready. timeline: RFC by next Wed, canary in ~2 weeks.
Sam: will open RFC and link here.
Kevin: +1. also write a brief failure-modes explainer for SRE.
Irene: :thumbsup:
Maya: thanks all — tagging product ops to keep finance in the loop. will link RFC when posted.
